title: In Search of Lost Time: West
description: There seem to be some peculiar, tall towers near the Fontaine Research Institute...

mainQuestExcel.title: In Search of Lost Time: West
mainQuestExcel.description: There seem to be some peculiar, tall towers near the Fontaine Research Institute...

dialogs.text: Whoa! So strict! Paimon definitely doesn't want to work for that guy!
Where do they get the nerve to talk about "a sense of collective honor"? Where's the honor in not even letting anyone eat?
He's not completely wrong.
What a baffling rule...
Well, discipline is important, but... surely this is taking it too far?
Right!? The more someone doesn't know how to get things done, the weirder they get about discipline and rules...
Huh? Come to think of it, if we also cause a commotion, we can probably lure that platoon leader Shumilov down, right?
#Then, we'd be able to get up there... {NICKNAME}, let's give it a try!

flow.stepDescription: Look for clues in the nearby camps

dialogs.text: (There's a memo stuck next to the lever on the right side of the console. In neat and elegant handwriting, it reads, "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!")
Pull the lever.
#Whoa! What are you doing, {NICKNAME}?
You pull the lever without the slightest hesitation.\nThe entire tower then immediately trembles with a thunderous, ear-splitting rumble. It's as if the sky is crumbling and the earth is splitting...
Then... with a pop, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape right into your hands.\nAll is quiet once more.
Is... Is that it?
Hmm... Paimon doesn't have a clue what's on it, but it looks pretty important...
#{NICKNAME}, why don't we keep this paper tape for now? Who knows, it might come in handy later...
We probably shouldn't touch it...
#R... Right. It does seem dangerous... {NICKNAME}, maybe we should take a step back...
Huh? It's a console just like the one in that other tower from before...
Pull the lever.
You pull the lever.\nJust like before, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape after a moment of rumbling and shaking...
Hmm, it's paper tape, just like before...
Paimon still doesn't get it, but we should probably take this stuff with us in case we need it later.
What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!
Pull the lever.
You pull the lever.\nAfter some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...
Great! Now we have the monitoring data from the Crepes Suzette Station!
#All that's left now is the Pate de Fruit Station. Let's go, {NICKNAME}!
What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!
Pull the lever.
You pull the lever.\nAfter some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...
Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!
#{NICKNAME}, let's go back to Broglie now!

questNarration.text: Thump... thump... thump...\nNot long after, hurried and frantic footsteps can be heard coming from higher up in the tower...
The platoon leader fled with his subordinates...
